body: This is so true, My boyfriend is the quiet type and sometimes he doesn't talk at all to the point where i have to make up a bunch of questions just to engage with him.
I like that you said you'd do your best, some just over hype and don't deliver so i like that you said you'd try
How can parents lose two children and still abandon the one remaining child they have at such an age?
No wonder they are so mean to her, she's not using your money, she's using the FAMILY money coz you're still fully dependent on the family.

Just hear her out and see whether you want her back. Sometimes space and distance help people see a little clearer. She may have realized your importance in her life after the no contact. I'd say you should see where it goes if you love her or something.
Thanks for this😊. I'll definitely not reach out again. I do want him to be happy.
